role: Process-wide stack of correlation tags (label-4hex) that debugLog prefixes onto every line while a flow (sync, workout) is open.
types: LogCorrelation: enum — ambient correlation scope stack

flags.text: The tag is process-global: any line from any thread during an open scope (e.g. CloudKit sync) is tagged with that flow even when unrelated, as the header admits.

units.does: Returns the innermost open scope's label, or nil.
Pushes a new Entry with label '<name>-<4 hex>' and returns its token.
Removes the entry with this token (no-op if already removed).
